title: Forlinx AM62L32 Local EVM A low-power industrial SBC powered by TI s AM62L32 Cortex-A53/M4F SoC
summary: Forlinx Embedded AM62L32 Local EVM is a low-power industrial SBC built around the Texas Instruments AM62L32 Arm Cortex-A53/M4 hybrid SoC.
